name: MonarchDonutChart
title: DonutChart
wrapsNative: Swift Charts Chart with SectorMark (innerRadius and angularInset); inside MonarchChartFrame with MonarchChartLegend and an AXChartDescriptor
summary: Parts of one whole as a donut inside a chart frame: the total in the middle, a legend of values and shares, folding of small segments into Other, and every segment in the data table.
whenToUse: For two to six parts of one whole where the share matters more than an exact comparison, such as assets by type on a dashboard card.
whenNotToUse: To compare or rank parts precisely, or for many categories, use MonarchBarList or MonarchBarChart. For values that change over time or do not add up to a whole, use MonarchBarChart or a line chart.
api: init(_ title: String, segments: [MonarchDonutChartSegment], description: String? = nil, centerValue: String? = nil, centerLabel: String? = nil, summary: String? = nil, sort: MonarchDonutChartSort = .descending, maxSegments: Int = 6, legendContent: MonarchDonutChartLegendContent = .both, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = .ready, size: CGFloat? = nil, thickness: CGFloat? = nil, percentDigits: Int = 0, showsCenterValue: Bool = true, showsLegend: Bool = true, isTableToggleShown: Bool = true, emptyMessage: String? = nil, footer: String? = nil, labels: MonarchDonutChartLabels = MonarchDonutChartLabels(), formatValue: ((Double) -> String)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchDonutChartSegment.init(_ key: String, label: String, value: Double, color: MonarchChartColor? = nil)

MonarchDonutChartLabels.init(frame: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), other: String? = nil, segment: String? = nil, value: String? = nil, share: String? = nil, total: String? = nil)
enum MonarchDonutChartLegendContent { case both, value, percent, none }

options.name: title
options.description: The chart's name: the frame heading and the donut's accessibility label.

options.name: segments
options.description: The parts: key, label, value (negative and non-finite count as 0) and an optional colour slot.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title.

options.name: centerValue
options.description: The large text in the middle.

options.name: centerLabel
options.description: Small text under the centre value, such as "assets".

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated spoken summary.

options.name: sort
options.description: Largest slice first, or the given order.

options.name: maxSegments
options.description: The most slices drawn (at least 2); the smallest beyond it fold into a neutral Other slice.

options.name: legendContent
options.description: What each legend entry shows after its label: both ("412 · 48%"), value, percent or none.

options.name: status
options.description: ready, loading, empty or error. Ready with a total of 0 shows empty.

options.name: size
options.description: The outer diameter, and the height kept in every status.

options.name: thickness
options.description: The ring's thickness, kept between 4 points and half the size.

options.name: percentDigits
options.description: Decimal places in shares.

options.name: showsCenterValue
options.description: Whether the middle shows the centre value.

options.name: showsLegend
options.description: Whether the legend shows beside or under the donut.

options.name: isTableToggleShown
options.description: Whether "View as table" is offered.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Other, Segment, Value, Share, Total and the frame's strings.

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Writes values in the centre, legend, table and summary. A number in the current locale by default.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the error status.

states.name: ready
states.description: The donut with its centre text and the legend.

states.name: folded
states.description: With more segments than maxSegments, the smallest are drawn as one Other slice in the neutral colour; the legend shows Other, the table lists every segment.

states.name: table
states.description: "View as table" replaces the donut with every segment, then the total, with Value and Share columns.

states.name: loading
states.description: The frame's muted placeholder of the donut's height, read as "Loading chart".

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState with "No data yet"; also shown automatically when the total is 0.

states.name: error
states.description: The frame's error, with Try again when onRetry is set.

appearance: Slices take the theme's data slots 1 to 5 in order, and Other the subtle text colour, over a ring in the muted background colour that shows in the gaps between slices. The centre value is heading text in the default text colour, the centre label caption text in the muted colour. Every colour is a theme role, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes are covered.
platformNotes: Built on Swift Charts SectorMark instead of the web's SVG circles. The web dims the other slices on hover and shows a native tooltip; iOS has no hover, and every value and share is already in the legend, so slices are not interactive. The centre value is a String rather than any node. The legend is MonarchChartLegend in a column beside the donut, moving under it when there is no room. Android ships the same MonarchDonutChart. Several closures are optional (formatValue, onRetry). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is formatValue.
accessibility: The donut, with its centre text, is one accessibility element labelled with the title. Its value is the generated summary ("Total 874. Laptops 412 (47%), …") or the summary parameter.
The donut carries an AXChartDescriptor with one value per segment and no total, so Audio Graphs compares the parts; point labels are the app's formatted values.
Each legend entry is one element read as its label, value and share; the colour marker is hidden.
"View as table" shows every segment, the total and the shares as text; each row is read as the segment, then its value and share.
Segments are told apart by the legend's names and the table, not by colour alone; slices are separated by a gap.
Every built-in word (Other, Segment, Value, Share, Total and the frame's strings) can be replaced through labels.
edgeCases: Negative and non-finite values count as 0; a total of 0 shows the empty state.
A share under the smallest step reads "<1%" and one just under the whole ">99%", so rounding never hides a segment; a very small slice can still be thinner than the gap on the ring.
maxSegments below 2 is treated as 2, so Other never stands alone.
A long centre value or label shrinks to half its size, then truncates, to stay inside the hole at large text sizes.
Long legend labels wrap; the legend moves under the donut when the row does not fit.
Audio Graphs was not tried with VoiceOver on a device; the descriptor and summary are unit-tested.

examples.title: Assets by type
examples.template:
MonarchDonutChart(
    {{title}},
    segments: [
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.0.key}}, label: {{segments.0.label}}, value: {{segments.0.value|double}}),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.1.key}}, label: {{segments.1.label}}, value: {{segments.1.value|double}}),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.2.key}}, label: {{segments.2.label}}, value: {{segments.2.value|double}}),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.3.key}}, label: {{segments.3.label}}, value: {{segments.3.value|double}}),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment({{segments.4.key}}, label: {{segments.4.label}}, value: {{segments.4.value|double}}),
    ],
    description: {{description}},
    centerLabel: {{centerLabel}}
)
examples.code:
MonarchDonutChart(
    "Assets by type",
    segments: [
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("laptop", label: "Laptops", value: 412.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("phone", label: "Phones", value: 268.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("monitor", label: "Monitors", value: 131.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("tablet", label: "Tablets", value: 54.0),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("other", label: "Accessories", value: 9.0),
    ],
    description: "All active assets",
    centerLabel: "assets"
)

examples.title: Shares only, a custom centre and a pinned neutral slice
examples.code:
MonarchDonutChart(
    "Storage",
    segments: [
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("files", label: "Files", value: 820),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("backups", label: "Backups", value: 540),
        MonarchDonutChartSegment("free", label: "Free", value: 640, color: .neutral),
    ],
    centerValue: "68%",
    centerLabel: "used",
    sort: .none,
    legendContent: .percent,
    formatValue: { "\($0.formatted()) GB" }
)
